answer: The relic cap is applied at the trellis settlement and visible in the beacon breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 27% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. Because of that, capturing the pool calls for several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
